research_question: Do causally generated conditional-volatility forecasts improve out-of-sample risk prediction and exposure management across three Chinese A-share instruments?

ChiNext.instrument: E Fund ChiNext ETF, not ChiNext index

price_adjustment_rule: Legacy raw Close is retained unchanged. Before extending, document provider auto_adjust/split/dividend policy and review any ETF corporate actions; do not splice adjusted and unadjusted prices.
decision_time: after market close at origin session t
training_rule: At any origin t, a sample is eligible only after its target_end_date <= t. Features must be measurable by close t.
target_comparison_rule: Evaluate the same target on identical origin and target timestamps for each model; report per-market and common-date panels.

validation.usage: chronological selection; legacy results already examined

new_holdout.usage: newly acquired post-legacy sample; freeze choices before fitting; not claimed guaranteed unseen

protocol_constraints: Never train on observations with target_end_date later than the current forecast origin.
For each window, include only observations whose target_end_date falls inside the same window.
No backfill of features, forecasts, returns or risk thresholds.
Do not replace or silently expand the six tracked legacy market CSVs.
Existing 2015-2024 results are legacy baselines and must not be described as untouched holdout.
No model-performance claims before a complete reproducible rerun.
data_readiness_reason: CSI 300 legacy raw file starts in 2021, and all three legacy raw files stop on 2024-12-30. Provenance-checked extensions are required before comparative validation and new holdout.
